review.summary: Round 4 reviews e9c12f5, which changes only the ending label color constant in GraphViewer, its style test expectation and the task file; main is still bb82b07 and the rest of the branch is unchanged since round 3. The ending node and edge labels now use #736c5e, which gives about 4.8:1 on the faded default node fill over white, 4.6:1 over the page canvas color and 5.2:1 on the white edge label box, so it meets the 4.5:1 that WCAG AA asks for 12px text while staying lighter than the normal node text. Every node type in the local data uses the default fill; a darker custom type color would lower the node label contrast, which the comment on the constant notes by naming the default fill. The task file records the change. The frontend format check, lint, all 434 tests and the build pass. No new findings.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: The developer chose to darken the label slightly; #736c5e meets 4.5:1 on the faded default node fill and on the edge label box, and the style test checks the new color.
